source.title: Descriptional Complexity of Finite Automata: Concepts and Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with identifier 2068876. Direct fetching of https://zbmath.org/2068876 was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, but the zbMATH API resolved the exact record as Juraj Hromkovic, "Descriptional Complexity of Finite Automata: Concepts and Open Problems", Journal of Automata, Languages and Combinatorics 7(4), pages 519-531, 2002, DOI 10.25596/jalc-2002-519.

failure_mode=paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI landing page resolved to https://jalc.de/issues/2002/issue_7_4/jalc-2002-519-531.php and exposed only article metadata, an abstract PDF, and a fulltext link requiring a personal account. The fulltext endpoint https://jalc.de/issues/2002/issue_7_4/fulltext/pp-519-531.pdf returned HTTP 401 with Basic realm "JALC Fulltext". The abstract endpoint https://jalc.de/issues/2002/issue_7_4/abs-519.pdf returned a PDF but was not accepted as a technical source because it is only an abstract preview.

Bounded exact-work recovery checked DBLP record journals/jalc/Hromkovi02, DOI 10.25596/jalc-2002-519, OpenAlex by DOI, Crossref by DOI, Semantic Scholar by DOI, Internet Archive exact-title search, and exact-title web searches. DBLP confirmed the DOI, OpenAlex reported no PDF URL, Crossref returned no work record for the DOI, Semantic Scholar reported no openAccessPdf URL, Internet Archive returned no exact-title records, and web candidates were ResearchGate request-only metadata, DBLP/JALC metadata, citations, reference lists, or related papers rather than a readable same-work full text.

No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered. Extracting from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, citations, or related papers would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/2068876.json and outputs/latest.json.
